name: skill-trace
description: A /skill-trace pane showing which skills loaded in this session, when, from which plugin, whether the model or you invoked them, and how large their instructions were

maxEntries.title: Max entries
maxEntries.description: How many skill loads the trace keeps; the oldest drop off first. Per-skill counts are kept regardless.

showArgs.title: Record arguments
showArgs.description: Record and show the arguments the model passed to the Skill tool (truncated to 80 characters).

statusLine.title: Status line count
statusLine.description: Show a compact skill-load count in the status line under the prompt.
